title: $42 Billion Pulled From One Bank in One Day #shorts
description:
On March 9, 2023, customers tried to withdraw $42 billion from Silicon Valley Bank (Federal Reserve review, April 2023). It was closed the next day. FDIC insurance covers up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, for each account ownership category.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
